# Codex fixture

This structural excerpt was checked against a local native Codex rollout and the
existing T1 structural probes on 2026-11-12. The message, custom tool, output,
reasoning and usage event shapes preserve the observed format. Identifiers,
timestamps, model name, tool input/output and token counts have been replaced
with deterministic development values. No task answers, local paths or credentials
are included. The opaque reasoning placeholder is intentionally absent from the
converted golden. Edge cases in the test file are synthetic, explicitly scoped
parser checks; they are not real integration evidence.
